question: Should this PR proceed as the canonical PR2 durable-runtime implementation before the durable-core RFC in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101828 is merged or reconciled?
rationale: The patch adds new persisted state, operator RPCs, CLI commands, and many environment surfaces; even after the correctness blockers are fixed, accepting that foundation is a maintainer product and upgrade-safety decision.

options.title: Fix Blockers Then Hold For Durable Direction
options.body: Require the contributor to restore the current gateway invariants and provide real behavior proof, then have a maintainer decide whether this PR is the canonical PR2 implementation stack.

options.title: Sponsor This As PR2
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly sponsor these durable runtime schema, CLI, and RPC surfaces as the intended implementation direction after the blocking regressions are repaired.

options.title: Pause Behind The RFC
options.body: Keep this implementation paused until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101828 or another canonical durable-runtime RFC is merged or superseded.

recommendation.title: Fix Blockers Then Hold For Durable Direction
recommendation.body: Require the contributor to restore the current gateway invariants and provide real behavior proof, then have a maintainer decide whether this PR is the canonical PR2 implementation stack.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is both the current assignee and the recent current-main owner signal for the affected gateway runtime paths.
